title: Tests turn the payment promises into evidence

rows:
Validate valid and invalid
requests and responses

Schemas, error bodies
and documented status codes

Repeat a request and
submit concurrent duplicates

Stable result and no
duplicate processing

Read or alter a payment
owned by another partner

Denied access and
appropriate audit evidence

Simulate a slow or
unavailable dependency

Agreed timeout, recovery
and consumer-visible status

Exercise a measured
peak traffic model

elements.text: These tests extend the scaffold with runtime evidence for the chosen implementation.

notes:
APIOps introduction. Technical continuation is illustrative; no client implementation or measured improvement is claimed.

Illustrative acceptance-test ideas derived from journey, architecture and contract decisions. No test execution or client performance result is claimed. The repository guidance includes functional, security and performance testing. Object-level access tests support the OWASP recommendation to validate permissions for requested objects. The scaffold does not supply this payment runtime or these application tests.
